author: Lucifist
body:
Alright, this is exactly the time to start taking advantage of the whole OCN situation. Hard luck OCN, but our Admins need to start doing shit right now. I'm not saying Avicus is gonna die because it's not lol, it's just gonna stalemate in my opinions.

Here's what I think needs to happen. Avicus needs to change its brand name. Avicus hasn't had a lot of major successes until now, but that's still very unclear. When an OCN player who hasn't played the server for let's say 12 months and hears someone say "let's go play avicus!", he will remember the last 12 months when he played Avicus. Now, if we go back 12 months, Avicus had shit staff, block lag, lag, and very shit maps. That player will instantly get that negative image of Avicus; therefore, I think changing the brand name to The Atlas Network would be better.

Everything is going into the right decision, I just feel we can upgrade the quality in maps, a bit in the staff side and a few more developers.
